metadata.description: Rem's buddy: Claude Code skills and hooks for coding standards, testing, architecture, git workflows, TDD bugfix

plugins.name: bugfix
plugins.description: TDD bug fix workflow: reproduce with a failing test, apply the minimal fix, commit

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Conventional commit, push, and GitLab MR workflows, plus a PreToolUse hook enforcing branch safety

plugins.name: coding-standards
plugins.description: Opinionated naming, comment, and docstring conventions for self-documenting code

plugins.name: python-testing
plugins.description: Python testing strategy and pytest conventions: three-tier split, fakes over mocks

plugins.name: python-architecture
plugins.description: Python backend architecture: hexagonal layers, DDD building blocks, MessageBus/UnitOfWork, CQRS

plugins.name: attribution-policy
plugins.description: Never add AI/tool attribution to commits, MRs, PRs, or docs — skill guidance plus a PreToolUse hook that blocks it deterministically

plugins.name: behavior-review
plugins.description: Behavior-scoped MR/PR review: does the change do what it promised, and is every behavior it changed pinned by a test

plugins.name: standards-review
plugins.description: Standards-scoped MR/PR review: conformity to the standards the repo declares for itself, architectural drift, and normative docs that no longer match the code

plugins.name: issue-workflow
plugins.description: Notion-issue-driven development loop: read spec, analyze, plan, implement, open MR, sync progress back to Notion
